author: Porkyyy
body:
I have already made a topic about this, but it was a while ago and nothing happened.

In Avicade (Red Alert to be specific), there is a kit called "griefer" and you unlock it at level 25.
What you get is a shovel which is:
1-either supposed to act a gun which shoots and destroys blocks, or
2-made to mine out the blocks on the map.

This kit is not working, so I am simply writing this to see what can be done about this glitch.

Thank you,
-Porky.
